user.title: Meal Plan
user.description: Set up a meal plan and shopping list. The calendars you pick are only ever read — nothing is written back to them.

data.name: Name
data.rollover_day: Roll over to the next week on
data.undated_stock: Allow stock items without an expiry date

data_description.calendars: Shown next to each day on the menu screen. Never written to.
data_description.menu_days: How many days the menu screen shows at once.
data_description.rollover_day: From this weekday on, the menu screen shows the coming window instead of the current one.
data_description.undated_stock: “There is still half a cucumber.” Undated items stay until you complete them; nothing disappears on its own.

data_description.menu_days: How many days the menu screen shows at once.

options.fresh: Fresh — bought because a meal is planned
options.pantry: Pantry — bought because it ran out

options.important: Important — track from the moment it is bought
options.near_only: Only when close — there is a date, but it is weeks away

add_dish.name: Add dish to list
add_dish.description: Puts a dish's fresh ingredients on the shopping list. Pantry ingredients are reported back rather than added.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

dish.name: Dish
dish.description: The dish, by the name the household uses for it.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: A multiplier for guests. Noted on the items; nothing is calculated.

include_pantry.name: Include pantry items
include_pantry.description: Add the pantry ingredients too instead of only reporting them.

running_low.name: Running low
running_low.description: Puts one article that is running low on a list.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

when.name: Which trip
when.description: This trip, or the next one.

plan_menu.name: Plan a day
plan_menu.description: Puts a dish on a date. Never adds anything to the shopping list.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

dish.name: Dish
dish.description: Leave empty to keep the day open — that is a normal state.

note.name: Note
note.description: Free text for that day. Stays with the plan; never written to a calendar.

people.name: People
people.description: How many are eating, if it matters.

complete_all.name: Complete the list
complete_all.description: Completes everything on the shopping list, except the items you name.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

sort_list.name: Sort the list
sort_list.description: Reorders the open items into the walking route of a store.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

set_store_order.name: Set the walking route
set_store_order.description: Records the order the departments come in at a store. Meant to be corrected in the aisle, not at a desk: the open list is re-sorted straight away.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

departments.name: Departments
departments.description: Department keys, in walking order. Any left out keep their order at the end.

check_off.name: Answer a round
check_off.description: Records what a round found: still enough, or run out. "Run out" puts it on the list straight away, or ticks it out of the house on the fridge round. Leaving the articles empty answers the whole round at once.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

articles.name: Articles
articles.description: What was looked at. Leave empty to answer everything the round is asking about.

enough.name: Still enough
enough.description: On for still enough, off for run out.

round.name: Round
round.description: The cupboard round or the fridge round.

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: Which cupboard round is being answered when no articles are named.

when.name: Which trip
when.description: Where a run-out article goes: this trip, or the next one.

reset_round.name: Start a round again
reset_round.description: Withdraws today's answers to a round, so everything is asked again. What the answers put on the list stays there.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

round.name: Round
round.description: The cupboard round or the fridge round.

move_item.name: Move an item
move_item.description: Moves something from one list to another. Not a new listing: it is the same item, on a different list.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

item.name: Item
item.description: What to move, by name or by uid.

move_all.name: Move a whole list
move_all.description: Moves everything still open on one list to another — "the next trip is now this trip". Always something somebody presses; never a date or a rollover.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

to.name: To list
to.description: Where it should all end up.

from.name: From list
from.description: Which list is emptied. The next trip by default.

set_dish.name: Set what a dish is
set_dish.description: Replaces a dish's ingredients with the list given, instead of adding to them. This is how an ingredient comes back out of a dish. How often it was eaten, and when, is left alone.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: The complete list. Anything left out is removed from the dish.

usual_day.name: Usual day
usual_day.description: The weekday this dish usually falls on. Empty clears it.

recipe_list.name: Recipe list
recipe_list.description: The name this dish goes by on the recipe list.

remove_dish.name: Remove a dish
remove_dish.description: Moves a dish to the bin, where it can be restored. Days already planned keep it: what was on the table is a fact.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

remove_article.name: Remove an article
remove_article.description: Moves an article to the bin and out of the dishes it was an ingredient of. Which dishes those were is remembered, so restoring puts it back. Lines already on a list are left alone.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

rename_article.name: Rename an article
rename_article.description: Renames an article everywhere it appears, history included — the counts and cadences are read from those events, so a rename that stopped short would make the article look brand new. Renaming onto a name that already exists merges the two.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

article.name: Article
article.description: The name as it is now.

merge_articles.name: Merge two articles
merge_articles.description: Folds one article into another, adding up what both of them knew. Two spellings of the same thing each carry half a history, which makes both look rarer than the thing is.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

set_department.name: Add or change a department
set_department.description: Adds a department, or changes one that exists. The order of the departments is the walking route, so a new one can be given a position in it.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

department.name: Key
department.description: The short key, e.g. `bakery`. Not shown on screen.

labels.name: Labels
labels.description: The name per language, keyed by language code — en, nl.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Whether things here are bought because a meal is planned, or because they ran out.

shelf_life.name: Shelf life
shelf_life.description: How much an expiry date matters here by default.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where it sits in the walking route. Left out, it goes to the end.

remove_department.name: Remove a department
remove_department.description: Removes a department after saying where its articles go. Never guessed: a department with thirty articles in it is thirty articles that end up somewhere.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

move_to.name: Move articles to
move_to.description: Where its articles go. Left out, they become unclassified.

set_store.name: Add a store
set_store.description: Adds a store, starting from the department order as it stands. Correct it in the aisle from there.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

remove_store.name: Remove a store
remove_store.description: Removes a store and the walking route that belonged to it.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

restore_deleted.name: Restore from the bin
restore_deleted.description: Takes a deleted article or dish back out of the bin, with everything it was attached to.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Whether it was an article or a dish.

discard_deleted.name: Empty something out of the bin
discard_deleted.description: Throws a deleted article or dish out for good. The other end of the bin: one nobody can empty is a place things accumulate rather than a safety net.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Whether it was an article or a dish.

forget_events.name: Forget a stretch of history
forget_events.description: Drops the events between two dates, optionally of one kind only. Blunt on purpose: it exists for a run of rows made by something that was not the household.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Only this kind of event. Left out, all of them.

list_articles.name: List the articles
list_articles.description: Every article alphabetically, with its department, how often it has been listed, when it last was, and which dishes use it.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

search.name: Search
search.description: Only articles whose name contains this.

list_departments.name: List the departments and stores
list_departments.description: The departments in walking order with how many articles sit in each, and the stores with when they were last shopped at.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

get_deleted.name: Read the bin
get_deleted.description: What has been deleted and can still be restored, most recent first.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

set_expiry.name: Set expiry date
set_expiry.description: Records when something in the house goes off.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

add_stock.name: Note what is in the house
add_stock.description: Adds something to the stock list, with or without an expiry date.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

expiry.name: Expiry date
expiry.description: Leave empty for something that simply needs using up.

learn_dish.name: Learn a dish
learn_dish.description: Adds a dish and its ingredients, or extends one that is already known.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

usual_day.name: Usual weekday
usual_day.description: If this dish tends to fall on one day.

recipe_list.name: Recipe name
recipe_list.description: The name in a recipe collection, if it differs.

learn_article.name: Place an article
learn_article.description: Puts an article in a department — the one tap that turns unknown into known.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

department.name: Department
department.description: A department key, for example produce or butcher.

shelf_life.name: Expiry tracking
shelf_life.description: Defaults to whatever the department says.

staple.name: Quick button
staple.description: Show this article as a quick button.

availability.name: Only available at
availability.description: A store name, if it is only sold there.

set_window.name: Stretch the window
set_window.description: Stretches the menu window, or puts it back to its natural length.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

extend_days.name: Extend by
extend_days.description: Days to add to the current end.

print_list.name: Print the list
print_list.description: Returns the shopping list as a printable page: one A4, two columns, department headings, a box per item.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

import_knowledge.name: Import knowledge
import_knowledge.description: Seeds departments, stores, articles and dishes from a knowledge file. An accelerator, not a prerequisite.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

replace.name: Replace departments
replace.description: Replace the department list instead of merging into it.

export_knowledge.name: Export knowledge
export_knowledge.description: Returns everything currently known, seeded and learned together, ready to be fetched.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

get_week.name: Get the week
get_week.description: Returns a week's menu with each day's calendar entries and notes.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

start.name: Start
start.description: Defaults to the current planning window.

get_history.name: Read the history
get_history.description: Returns what has happened — listed, bought, eaten, checked — most recent first. Without filters, the whole history a page at a time.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

since.name: From
since.description: Only events on or after this day.

until.name: Until
until.description: Only events on or before this day.

article.name: Article
article.description: Only what happened to this article.

dish.name: Dish
dish.description: Only what happened to this dish.

offset.name: Skip
offset.description: How many to skip — use with the total to walk through everything.

get_list.name: Read a list
get_list.description: Returns one list grouped under department headings, in the walking order of the selected store.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

list.name: List
list.description: This trip, the next trip, or what is in the house.

include_completed.name: Include completed
include_completed.description: Include the items already ticked off.

list_dishes.name: List dishes
list_dishes.description: Returns every dish with its frequency, last served, usual weekday and ingredients.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

get_pantry_check.name: What to check
get_pantry_check.description: Returns the pantry articles worth checking you still have.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: Everything due by its cadence, or the pantry items of the planned menu.

get_expiring.name: What is expiring
get_expiring.description: Returns what goes off within a number of days.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

suggest_menu.name: Suggest a menu
suggest_menu.description: Suggests dishes for the empty days. Dishes only — never a shopping list.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

start.name: Start
start.description: Defaults to the current planning window.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days to suggest for.

limit.name: Candidates per day
limit.description: How many suggestions to return per day.

unknown_dish.message: There is no dish called “{dish}”. Teach it first with Learn a dish.

unknown_entry.message: There is no meal plan with id {entry_id}.

no_meal_plan.message: No meal plan is set up.

no_store.message: No store is selected, so there is nothing to record a walking route for.

unknown_item.message: There is nothing called "{item}" on any list.

not_in_the_bin.message: There is nothing called "{name}" in the bin.

merge_with_itself.message: An article cannot be merged into itself.

check_off_needs_articles.message: Say which articles have run out. Only "still enough" can answer a whole round at once.

ambiguous_meal_plan.message: There is more than one meal plan. Say which one.

undated_stock_disabled.message: Stock items without an expiry date are switched off for this meal plan.

unsupported_schema.message: This knowledge file uses schema {schema}; this version reads {expected}.
